A '''crystal forest''' was created in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] when the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creature called [[Gracca]] used the [[Magic/Legends|magical]] powers of his [[Crystal Cloak]] to plant several [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] on the [[Floating Mountain]]. Several crystal spires emerged from the ground around the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], who had come to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] to recover the crystal cloak. During the [[Skirmish on the Floating Mountain|skirmish]] that followed, Gracca inadvertently flew into one of the spires, causing many of them to fall down and trap him within them.
